subject: type_property_flag_vocabulary
claim: On the r806919.Wizard_1_610 type dump, all 49,465 reflected properties set only 21 property-flag bits; the occurrence and distinct-class totals per bit are listed, along with every class hash and name and its property count for each bit.

classes.name: class MadlibArgT<class std::basic_string<char,struct std::char_traits<char>,class std::allocator<char> > const >*

how_to_repeat: Run `typeextract --client <your Wizard101 install> --out <temporary dump.json>` and confirm the reported revision is r806919.Wizard_1_610.

For every class in the dump `classes` object, inspect each property numeric `flags` value (treat an omitted field as zero). For each set bit from 0 through 31, count one property occurrence; count a class once for each bit it uses. Use the bit positions and names in `src/server/shared/ObjectProperty/PropertyFlags.h`.

Compare each class hash, name, and per-bit property count with the `classes` records here; compare totals with `flags`. As a tool spot check, run `client --type-dump <temporary dump.json> types 1972400702` and verify all four `PathActionChangeDirection` properties report `Save|Copy|Public`.
evidence: `typeextract` regenerated the dump from the local r806919.Wizard_1_610 install and reported 6,986 classes and 49,465 properties.

The dump has 49,465 properties with nonzero flags across 6,284 classes that have properties; 702 classes have none. Exactly 21 flag positions occur, and no other bit positions are set. `flags` gives per-bit property and class totals; `classes` gives the class name/hash and exact number of properties carrying each bit.
The built `client` tool query for class hash 1972400702 identifies `PathActionChangeDirection`; its four properties each print `Save|Copy|Public`, matching bits 0, 1 and 2 in the dump.
disproof: A fresh typeextract run on r806919.Wizard_1_610 that sets an unlisted bit, changes any per-bit property or class total, or produces a different per-class property count refutes this finding.
